insights: **Weekly Highlights —** MAC Energy delivered $89,696 in total sales for Week 46, up 16.6% from $76,932 the prior week, on 3534 units. Organic sales grew 31.5% to $46,321, led by the 4-in-1 Variety Pack at $41,630 (+19.8%) with conversion up to 37.6%. Orange Creamsicle ($11,044, +24.7%) and Forbidden Green Apple ($12,835, +19.7%) also posted strong gains, and Friday, Nov 13 was the peak day at $14,799.

**Metrics to Watch —** Ad spend rose to $75,332 from $37,447 while PPC revenue grew 4.0% to $43,374, so ROAS fell to 0.58x from 1.11x and TACoS climbed to 84.0% from 48.68%. Sessions eased on the Variety Pack (4402, -21.0%) and Macberry Lychee (2515, -25.2%), so this week's priority is bringing spend back in line with returns while protecting organic momentum.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $75,332 returned $43,374 in PPC revenue at a 0.58x ROAS and 173.7% ACOS. Ad conversion held healthy at 16.92% of clicks, but the 0.18% ad CTR shows we are paying for a lot of impressions that do not earn clicks, which is the main efficiency lever to pull.

**Actions This Week —** We will scale back bids and budgets on the highest-ACOS campaigns to bring spend toward the prior week's $37,447 level, pause non-converting search terms, and redirect budget to the Variety Pack and Orange Creamsicle, which are converting at 37.6% and 29.9%. We will also test new Sponsored Brand and video ad creative to lift the 0.18% ad CTR heading into the holiday season.
